title: A Dinosaur-Eating Mammal
content: Here are two concept sketches of the Cretaceous mammal Repenomamus.It's an extinct badger sized animal who raided dinosaur nests.I also made a maquette out of an air-dry craft foam.The finished painting of is fully documented in aGumroad tutorialcalled "The Mammal That Ate Dinosaurs."The illustration appeared in an article on paleo mammals inScientific American.
